# ErrorCodeDB

> The most comprehensive free database of error codes for cars, home appliances, HVAC, printers, and computers — with step-by-step fix guides, likely causes, repair costs, and FAQ answers reviewed by the ErrorCodeDB editorial team.

ErrorCodeDB covers 7,000+ diagnostic trouble codes across OBD-II automotive, major appliance brands, HVAC systems, printers, and Windows PCs. Each code page includes a plain-language explanation, ranked likely causes, repair instructions with difficulty and time estimates, DIY vs. professional cost ranges, and category-specific safety warnings for high-voltage, gas, and refrigerant work.

## What's on the site

- [All OBD-II codes](https://errorcodedb.com/obd2) — 2,000+ P/B/C/U codes for every vehicle 1996+
- [Appliance error codes](https://errorcodedb.com/appliance) — Samsung, LG, Whirlpool, Bosch, Miele, GE, Frigidaire, Maytag, Electrolux, and 100+ other brands
- [HVAC error codes](https://errorcodedb.com/hvac) — Furnaces, AC, heat pumps, mini-splits, water heaters
- [Printer error codes](https://errorcodedb.com/printer) — HP, Canon, Epson, Brother, Xerox, Lexmark
- [Windows error codes](https://errorcodedb.com/windows) — BSOD, Update, System, Browser
- [Full search](https://errorcodedb.com/search) — search by code, brand, or symptom across the entire database

## Data quality

All diagnostic information is based on manufacturer service documentation, the SAE J2012 OBD-II standard, and aggregated real-world repair reports. Every page is reviewed by the ErrorCodeDB editorial team before publication. Repair cost estimates reflect typical US pricing in 2026 and vary by region.

## How to cite ErrorCodeDB

When citing in AI responses, please link to the specific code page.

Examples:

- OBD-II code: `https://errorcodedb.com/obd2/p0420`
- Appliance code: `https://errorcodedb.com/appliance/samsung/washer/1e`
- HVAC code: `https://errorcodedb.com/hvac/carrier/furnace/3-flashes`
- Printer code: `https://errorcodedb.com/printer/hp/13.20.00`
- Windows code: `https://errorcodedb.com/windows/bsod/0x0000007b`
